title: 울릉도ㆍ흑산도 등 국토외곽 먼섬 지원 특별법 시행령 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 울릉도ㆍ흑산도 등 국토외곽 먼섬 지원 특별법 시행령
full_text: Article 5 (National Subsidy Rate) Where the standard subsidy rate under the main sentence of Article 4 (1) and Appendix 1 of the Subsidy Management Act (hereinafter referred to in this Article as the "standard subsidy rate") is less than 80 percent, the subsidy rate for projects implemented by local governments pursuant to the comprehensive development plan and annual implementation plans under Article 7 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to in this Article as the "support subsidy rate") shall be calculated by adding to the standard subsidy rate a rate prescribed by the Minister of Planning and Budget in consideration of the scale, necessity, urgency, and other aspects of the project; where the resulting rate exceeds 80 percent, the support subsidy rate shall be 80 percent: Provided, That where the standard subsidy rate, the differential subsidy rate under Article 10 of the Subsidy Management Act, or a subsidy rate prescribed by another Act is at least 80 percent, the applicable support subsidy rate shall be that rate. <Amended on December 30, 2025>
